capabilities: organize task notes into ordered chains with per-chain position and status
browse and reorder chains from a status bar and side panel
create new task notes from a template into a chosen folder
import and two-way sync Linear issues, projects, and initiatives as notes
import issues from a self-hosted Task App as notes
disambiguation: Not a checkbox task-list manager; it treats each task as a whole note with frontmatter and arranges notes into ordered chains.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; both integrations are optional and send nothing until configured.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to treat tasks as standalone notes with frontmatter status and to sequence them in ordered chains across projects.

relations.evidence: import issues, projects and initiatives from Linear workspaces as notes, sync status in both directions
import issues from your self-hosted Task App as notes
the same look as the Note Types plugin's styled links

requires.name: Linear workspace (OAuth sign-in with your own Linear OAuth app client ID, or a personal API key)
self-hosted Task App with an /mcp endpoint and API_TOKEN

summary: Task manager that stores each task as a Markdown note and organizes them into ordered chains with a status bar and side panel for browsing and reordering.
